title: The Kingdom of Laravel.io
tagline: Founded in 2012 by Dries Vints. 2.8k commits of forum threads, articles and spam wars.

Models.name: The Archives
Models.lore: Every user, thread and reply in the kingdom is recorded here. Half the city imports someone from this hill.

Http/Controllers.name: Gatekeepers' Quarter
Http/Controllers.lore: Every HTTP request knocks on one of these doors first. They validate, delegate to Jobs, and return a view.

Jobs.name: Courier Docks
Jobs.lore: Controllers never do the work themselves: they dispatch a Job from here. CreateThread, UpdateReply, BanUser...

tests.name: Training Grounds
tests.lore: 76 inspectors drill the city daily. ArticleTest alone grew into a 500-line monster.

resources.name: Gallery Lane
resources.lore: Blade painters. The forum thread page has been repainted more than 100 times.

Filament.name: The Admin Citadel
Filament.lore: Moderators rule from here. Careful: three rifts were opened between Resources and their Pages.

app/Models/User.php.title: The Elder
lines: I am User. 119 citizens import me. I am the most depended-upon soul in this kingdom.
I know your github_id, your bio, and if you were ever banned_reason... I remember everything.
I carry 71 methods and three ranks: DEFAULT, MODERATOR, ADMIN. Ask UserPolicy what each may do.
Some say I've grown too big. 448 lines... One day someone will split me into traits. Not today.

app/Models/Thread.php.title: Keeper of Questions
lines: I'm Thread. Every forum question starts with me.
When a reply answers me, call markSolution() and I'll remember who solved it, and who marked it.
Rebuilt 70 times. Locking, spam reports, solutions, subscriptions... everyone wanted a feature from me.

app/Http/Controllers/Forum/ThreadsContro.title: Gatekeeper of the Forum
lines: Requests to /forum come through my door.
I never write to the database myself. I validate with a Request, then dispatch CreateThread or UpdateThread to the Courier Docks.
Want to follow a request end-to-end? Start with me, then visit the Docks.

quests.title: The Elder
quests.text: One citizen is imported by 119 others. Find the heart of the kingdom.

quests.title: Ask a Question
quests.text: Forum requests enter through one gate. Find the forum's gatekeeper.

quests.title: Who Solves It?
quests.text: Find the citizen who knows how to mark a reply as the solution.

quests.title: The Monster of the Training Grounds
quests.text: A 500-line test grew into a god. Confront it.

quests.title: Pay Respects
quests.text: Visit the graveyard of deleted files.

quests.title: Close the Rift
quests.text: Three Filament resources import their own pages and vice versa. Investigate the Rift.
